Title: Don't be like everyone else

```{r}
test <- read_csv("KCLYakkertechData.csv") 

test <- test |> 
    filter(!is.na(PitchCall)) |> 
    filter(!(PitchCall %in% c("BallCalled", "HitByPitch", "StrikeCalled", "IntentionalWalk", "StrikeLooking"))) |> 
    mutate(isWhiff = ifelse(PitchCall == "StrikeSwinging", 1, 0)) |> 
    filter(AutoTaggedPitchType == "Fastball")

df_bin <- test %>%
  mutate(speed_bin = floor(RelSpeed)) %>%
  group_by(speed_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    whiffPct = mean(isWhiff, na.rm = TRUE),
    count    = n()
  )

ggplot(df_bin, aes(
    x = speed_bin, y = whiffPct,
    size = count, fill = whiffPct
  )) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, colour = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(1)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Whiff %") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 12) +
  labs(
    x = "Speed Bin (mph)",
    y = "Whiff Percentage",
    title = "Whiff % vs. Speed (bubble size = sample count)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
  

```

```{r}
test <- read_csv("KCLYakkertechData.csv") 
test <- test |> 
  filter(AutoTaggedPitchType == "Fastball") |> 
  filter(!is.na(InducedVertBreak) & !is.na(HorzBreak)) |> 
  filter(!is.na(PlayResult)) |> 
  filter(!is.na(ExitSpeed) & !is.na(Angle)) |> 
  filter(PitcherThrows == "Left")  |> 
  mutate(
    z_h = (HorzBreak        - mean(HorzBreak,        na.rm=TRUE)) / sd(HorzBreak,        na.rm=TRUE),
    z_v = (InducedVertBreak - mean(InducedVertBreak, na.rm=TRUE)) / sd(InducedVertBreak, na.rm=TRUE),
    category = if_else(abs(z_h) <= 1 & abs(z_v) <= 1, "normal", "unique")
  )

test |> 
  group_by(category) |> 
  summarise(
    n        = n(),
    mean_xslg= mean(predicted_xslg, na.rm=TRUE),
    sd_xslg  = sd(predicted_xslg, na.rm=TRUE)
  )

ggplot(test, aes(sample = predicted_xslg, color = category)) +
  stat_qq() + stat_qq_line() +
  facet_wrap(~category)

tt <- t.test(
  predicted_xslg ~ category,
  data       = test,
  alternative = "two.sided"   # default; use "greater" or "less" for one-sided
)
tt

```

```{r}
test <- read_csv("KCLYakkertechData.csv")

test <- test |> 
  filter(AutoTaggedPitchType == "Fastball") |>
  filter(PitcherThrows == "Right")

horzLow <- quantile(test$HorzBreak, .001, na.rm = TRUE)
horzHigh <- quantile(test$HorzBreak, .999, na.rm = TRUE)

vertLow <- quantile(test$InducedVertBreak, .001, na.rm = TRUE)
vertHigh <- quantile(test$InducedVertBreak, .999, na.rm = TRUE)

test <- test |> 
  filter(HorzBreak >= horzLow & HorzBreak <= horzHigh) |> 
  filter(InducedVertBreak >= vertLow & InducedVertBreak <= vertHigh)

test |> 
  mutate()

test |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = HorzBreak, y = InducedVertBreak)) +
  geom_point()
```


```{r}

heat <- test %>%
  mutate(hbin = cut_width(HorzBreak, 1.5),
         vbin = cut_width(InducedVertBreak, 1.5)) %>%
  group_by(hbin, vbin) %>%
  summarize(avg_pred = mean(predicted_xslg, na.rm=TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

ggplot(heat, aes(x = hbin, y = vbin, fill = avg_pred)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low  = "white",
    high = "red",
    name = "Avg xSLG"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Horizontal Break (°)", 
    y = "Vertical Break (°)",
    title = "Fastball xSLG Heatmap by Break"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```


```{r}
test <- read_csv("savantData2425.csv") |> 
  filter(
    pitch_type  == "FF",
    pitch_hand  == "R",
    !is.na(pfx_x), !is.na(pfx_z),
    !is.na(events),
    !is.na(launch_speed), !is.na(launch_angle)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    InducedVertBreak = 12 * pfx_z,
    HorzBreak       = 12 * pfx_x
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    z_h = (HorzBreak        - mean(HorzBreak,        na.rm=TRUE)) / sd(HorzBreak,        na.rm=TRUE),
    z_v = (InducedVertBreak - mean(InducedVertBreak, na.rm=TRUE)) / sd(InducedVertBreak, na.rm=TRUE),
    category = if_else(abs(z_h) <= 1 & abs(z_v) <= 1, "normal", "unique")
  )

test |> 
  group_by(category) |> 
  summarise(
    n        = n(),
    mean_xslg= mean(estimated_slg_using_speedangle, na.rm=TRUE),
    sd_xslg  = sd(  estimated_slg_using_speedangle, na.rm=TRUE)
  )

# 2) Remove extreme outliers (e.g. top/bottom 1% of each break)
break_limits <- test %>% summarize(
  h_low  = quantile(HorzBreak,        0.01),
  h_high = quantile(HorzBreak,        0.99),
  v_low  = quantile(InducedVertBreak, 0.01),
  v_high = quantile(InducedVertBreak, 0.99)
)

test_filtered <- test %>% 
  filter(
    between(HorzBreak,        break_limits$h_low,  break_limits$h_high),
    between(InducedVertBreak, break_limits$v_low,  break_limits$v_high)
  )

# 3) Bin, summarize & throw away bins with too few pitches
heat <- test_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    hbin = cut_width(HorzBreak,        width = 1.5),
    vbin = cut_width(InducedVertBreak, width = 1.5)
  ) %>%
  group_by(hbin, vbin) %>%
  summarise(
    n        = n(),
    avg_pred = mean(estimated_slg_using_speedangle, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n >= 20)   # only keep bins with ≥ 20 pitches

# 4) Plot
ggplot(heat, aes(x = hbin, y = vbin, fill = avg_pred)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red", name = "Avg xSLG") +
  labs(
    x     = "Horizontal Break (in)",
    y     = "Induced Vertical Break (in)",
    title = "Fastball xSLG Heatmap by Break"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```





```{r}

df <- read_csv("KCLPitcherSavantData.csv") |> 
  filter(IP > 3)

bottomQ <- as.numeric(quantile(df$FastballVelo, .25))
middleQ <- as.numeric(quantile(df$FastballVelo, .5))
upperQ <- as.numeric(quantile(df$FastballVelo, .75))

df <- df |> 
  mutate(
    FastballVeloGroup = case_when(
      FastballVelo < bottomQ ~ 1,
      FastballVelo >= bottomQ & FastballVelo < middleQ ~ 2,
      FastballVelo >= middleQ & FastballVelo < upperQ ~ 3,
      FastballVelo >= upperQ ~ 4
    )
  )

df |> 
  group_by(FastballVeloGroup) |> 
  summarise(
    ERA = 
  )

df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = FastballVelo, y = whiffPct)) +
  geom_point()
```


```{r}
test <- read_csv("KCLYakkertechData.csv")

test <- test %>%
  group_by(Batter, Date) |> 
  filter(PlayResult %in% c("Out")) %>%
  filter(predicted_xba > 0) |> 
  summarise(maxXBA = max(predicted_xba, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_exit_speed = sum(!is.na(ExitSpeed)),
            .groups = "drop")

ps <- c(.403, .366, .250, .140, .353)
mean(ps)

dist <- c(1 - ps[1], ps[1])

for(i in 2:length(ps)) {
  pi   <- ps[i]
  dist <- convolve(dist, rev(c(1 - pi, pi)), type = "open")
}

names(dist) <- 0:5
dist

df_dist <- tibble(
  hits = as.integer(names(dist)),  # 0,1,2,3,4,5
  prob = as.numeric(dist)
)

ggplot(df_dist, aes(x = hits, y = prob)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:5) +
  labs(
    x     = "# Hits",
    y     = "",
    title = "Expected Number of Hits"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
